environment.method: Three fresh Node processes, five identical real retained pins per process, each with a fresh GIS Python worker and disposable SQLite epoch. Sequential indexed/full pairs; no OS cache flush. Full validation on every open. Scan reuses accepted native predicates with independent literal/geometry/graph expectations in tests. Parent RSS observed, not aggregate peak.
environment.qualifierProfiles: Completeness counts projected from measured all/explicit-unknown query result populations, after timed calls; no timestamps inferred.

setup.physicalIO: current verification/reconstruction and GDAL/archive reads are additional; member parse bytes and hash bytes are logical, not cold disk traffic
